preamble: Denasalization and lowering of the nasalized close-mid front vowel [ẽ] to the open front unrounded vowel [a]. This shift involves loss of nasality through denasalization and simultaneous lowering of vowel height, occurring historically in Slavic languages before nasal consonants or in liaison contexts.

examples.note: Proto-Slavic nasal vowel [ę] underwent denasalization with lowering to [ɛ]/[a] in various South Slavic dialects and Old Church Slavic recensions.
Nasal vowels in Proto-Slavic developed into [ɛ̃] in Polish, later denasalizing and lowering in certain contexts, particularly before obstruents.

sources: Wikipedia contributors (2026). Phonological history of French. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phonological_history_of_French
